blocks.orig: The Serena Mivumo River Lodge provides a serene retreat amidst the unspoilt beauty of the stunning Julius Nyerere National Park. The 12 spacious chalets offer thatched roofs, wooden floors and an appealing blend of Edwardian elegance and contemporary comfort. From your terrace, you enjoy unparalleled views of the wilderness, as well as from your outside shower. Families or groups can choose to stay in the Mivumo Villa, which offers three double ensuite bedrooms, a private deck with sun loungers, a plunge pool and a rain shower. Perched on timber decks above the awe-inspiring Rufiji River, the spacious and light-filled dining room is an ideal spot to begin or end your day. Enjoy the comfortable sofas in the open bar and the uninterrupted views of hippos, elephants and crocodiles that congregate on the riverbank as the sun sets and you savour your drink after a splendid day of safari.
blocks.html: In the untouched beauty of the magnificent Julius Nyerere National Park, the Serena Mivumo River Lodge offers a peaceful retreat. Its 12 roomy chalets have thatched roofs, wooden floors and an attractive mix of Edwardian elegance and modern comfort. Both your terrace and your outdoor shower give you exceptional views over the wilderness. Families or groups can opt for the Mivumo Villa, with three double ensuite bedrooms, a private deck with sun loungers, a plunge pool and a rain shower. Raised on timber decks above the impressive Rufiji River, the large, bright dining room is a perfect place to start or finish your day. Sink into the comfortable sofas in the open bar and watch, without obstruction, the hippos, elephants and crocodiles that gather on the riverbank at sunset while you enjoy a drink after a wonderful safari day.
